name: receipts
description: Stop-hook claim auditor: every **FACT:** / 'verified' / 'tests pass' claim must trace to a real tool call in the transcript, or Claude is flagged (or blocked, in block mode) until it proves the claim or downgrades it to **ASSUME:**. Hybrid deterministic prefilter + fresh-context Haiku judge. On by default (mode: warn), fail-open.
